question: Can a learned local3x3 update rule grow the declared v3a fin/ray image and preserve or recover it under unseen stochastic updates and damage masks?
scope: Inverse image-pattern optimization only; not observed tissue, biochemical signals, DNA design, biological nervous system or a validated organism

target.interpretation: ONE synthetic design goal projected from existing biological v3a fin geometry/rays, not an empirical image

model.hidden_channel_meaning: none assigned; dimensionless computational state, not measured chemicals/voltage
model.perception: fixed per-channel identity,SobelX/8,SobelY/8 over3x3 with zero padding
model.learned_rule: 1x1 conv48->128,ReLU,1x1 conv128->16, residual state increment; last layer initial weights/bias0
model.living_mask: (max_pool3x3(alpha_pre)>.1) AND (max_pool3x3(alpha_post)>.1); all channels zero outside mask
model.time_units: one computational update; no biological seconds or cell-size calibration

training.comparison: Both use identical pool training and budgets; only explicit circular damage differs. Undamaged-pool is growth/persistence without damage, not fresh-seed-only training.
training.pool_note: Reduced from official notebook1024 as declared adaptation
training.gradient: Each parameter gradient divided by itsL2norm+1e-8, finite checks before update
training.loss: Unweighted rawRGBA mean squared error against premultiplied target; no clipping of model states
training.seed: one computational pixel at frozen projected rootxy; RGB0,alpha+hidden1
training.pool_update: sample8withoutreplacement,sort by targetMSEdescending,reseedworst; detach outputs backinto samepoolindices
training.damage_training: damage only3lowest-loss selectedstates with random circular erasure of ALL16channels; centersnormalized[-.5,.5],radii[.1,.4]; no heldout mask file read
training.rng_policy: Separate paired streams for initialization,poolselection/unroll,stochasticfire and trainingdamage; same seed draws across regimes; no biological replication implied
training.checkpoint_scope: Weights,optimizer,step,RNG states; pool not serialized, so no exact resume claim
training.holdout_barrier: Finish or explicitly abort training phase, save final completed checkpoints+SHAmanifest BEFORE loading heldout masks or computing holdout metrics. Evaluate fixed final2000-step checkpoints only; no holdout model selection or tuning.

damage.operator: zero ALL16channels in frozen mask, record both pre/postevent states at update256

negative_all_erased.expected_property: all-zero absorbing state; no spontaneous pattern; report separately from primary damage tests

evaluation.design_match_predicate: IoU>=.75 AND rawRGBA_MSE<=.02 at declared checkpoints; thresholds fixed before training
evaluation.persistence_predicate: design_match at every saved checkpoint from256 through1024; scope saved checkpoints only
evaluation.recovery_predicate: design_match before damage at256 AND after512recoveryupdates; failure to establish predamage pattern counts as failure
evaluation.comparison: Paired differences across declared model/update seeds and masks; descriptive ranges, not biological success probabilities; show all candidates/failures
evaluation.display_clipping: RGBA display conversion may clip to[0,1], explicitly renderer-only; rawstate metrics and snapshots retained
evaluation.trace_sampling_scope: Full RGBA histories/full-state snapshots only for update_seed7001 in undamaged persistence and central-square damage, selected before training. All52evaluationruns retain metrics every16updates and actual finalRGBA.

controls.cpu_tiny_optimizer: Finite nonzero gradient and changed weights on a bounded actual optimization step; no asserted target learning
controls.local_rule_radius: Learned perception3x3; composed pre/post-living mask has bounded5x5 dependency. No global target or coordinate input at rollout.
controls.negative_control: Untrained/zero updater and all-erased controls must fail the design-match target while staying finite

resources.checkpoint_and_trace_transport: Preserve partial checkpoints/logs; optional multi-part output if archive>16MiB; no truncation or replacement runs

sources.evidence: source-only model reference; not independent biological validation

sources.adaptation: PyTorch implementation,128pool,2000steps,onefish-derived target; not exact published benchmark reproduction

checklist: matched damage ablation and all failures
actual saved-state video and final source/output hashes
pre_training_clarification: The official pre/post living-mask composition widens total one-step dependency beyond the learned3x3 perception. Clarified before model implementation, controls or training, not after a failed result.
